auditor_value: x₁ + x₂ = constant ⇒ v₁ + v₂ = 0 ⇒ a₁ = −a₂ (equal magnitude, opposite direction)

findings.quote: so the sum of the speeds is zero
findings.note: Speeds are magnitudes and cannot sum to zero while the blocks move; the quantities that sum to zero are the signed rates dx₁/dt and dx₂/dt (velocities along the chosen downward-positive axis).
findings.fix: so the sum of the two velocities dx₁/dt + dx₂/dt is zero, and the sum of the accelerations is zero too.

notes: Independent constraint derivation agrees: a₁ = −a₂. The equation lines are all correct; the only defect is the word 'speeds' in steps[1].
